items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: And had a fellow by the name of Trappee played drum.

ctx.x: Well who was Duran? Who was Duran? Duran? Oh he was a trumpet player. Oh. Yeah.

That's Maurice, or his father? He was, Duran played with, with Peter and then, let's say they had Duran, that's like what they do running up the band at that time. And had a fellow by the name of Trappee played drum. Trappee, huh? Yeah, just called him Trappee. Kind of drums came through with you. He was a nice drummer. That's not Nines. Huh? That's Nines? Yes, is that the same guy they call Nines? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, but he used to call him Trappee for, I guess they call him that for sure. Yeah, Trappanier.…
Oh, what about the, uh, the Egalite Hall, the Eagle Eye Hall?
